summary: Join our Digital Customer Experience Management Training to discover best practices and innovative techniques for delivering exceptional customer experiences.
lede: Digital customer experience management helps managers design and assess customer interactions across digital and human touchpoints. For leaders of customer-facing channels, service, marketing, and products, the course develops practical ways to map journeys, identify friction, and use customer feedback and digital measures. Participants also learn to align teams across channels and prioritize improvements against customer and business outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals managing or influencing digital customer touchpoints and experiences. It appeals to those who need to justify digital initiatives using customer experience and business outcomes.
audience: Product owners and product managers for apps
Contact center and customer service managers
modules: Foundations of Digital Customer Experience Management
Understanding Your Customer and Their Expectations
Digital Service Quality, UX, and Accessibility
Data, Analytics, and Personalization in CX
Leading CX Change and Aligning Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have basic familiarity with digital channels and customer service concepts. Experience in managing digital projects or customer-facing roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
